notes: 2026-07-30 nightly: NO strategy parameter changed on either engine, but the MEASUREMENT that justified strategy 2 was wrong and every backtest number in the record is now restated. THE BUG: indicators.fetch_candles overwrites the open/high/low/close columns with Heikin Ashi, keeping the true values only in real_*. strategy2.signal() correctly prices entry from real_close, but backtest2.backtest_coin walked the trade over the HA columns -- so a real entry was simulated against a synthetic path. HA high is by construction max(real_high, ha_open, ha_close) and HA low the matching min, measured 14% wider bars and ha_close off the real close by 0.21% on average, which on a 10-25x leveraged 1R target is enormous. Fixed with a path= argument on backtest_coin, defaulting to real. RESTATED, 20 coins, 5000 bars, fees in, live ratchet semantics (partial_at_r=1.0, partial_pct=0.0, trail_step_r=0.25): HA (what was believed) n=121 WR 66.9% +72.44% maxDD -4.23%; REAL n=120 WR 50.0% +29.97% maxDD -11.01%. EV/trade +0.250% not +0.655%, t=1.95 (was ~4.4), median trade +0.019%, positive months 3 of 7 not 7 of 8, and dropping the best 10 of 120 trades turns the system negative (-2.52%). The edge is real but it is a fat tail, not a win rate. SECOND FINDING: the entry signal on its own has no edge -- fixed TP at 1R measures n=121 WR 50.4% -2.82%. 100% of strategy 2's return comes from the ratchet converting the ~8% of trades that run. That made the ratchet the highest-stakes untested code in the system (it has never executed live; the only live trade stopped out before 1R), so it was audited and a real bug was found: executor.update_sl cancels the resting TP and stop BEFORE placing the new one, but was the single order site in that file not checking its result -- every other one checks the outer status AND the inner status because an outer 'ok' can mask an inner error. A rejected ratchet stop was therefore recorded as a success, so live._check_trail_s2 advanced its stored stop, stopped retrying, and left the position with NO stop and NO take-profit, silently and permanently. update_sl now raises on either status; _check_trail_s2 leaves its stored stop untouched so the next 20s poll retries, and DMs the owner once per position while it is unprotected. New test_ratchet.py covers the whole path (arm at 1R, TP cancellation, rung arithmetic both directions, monotonicity, failure leaves the stop unmoved, retry re-protects) -- 9/9 pass, and it mutes live's logger so it cannot write fake events into bot.log the way the 07-29 watchdog test did. NOT CHANGED and why: re-derived every bucket on real prices since the 07-28 tables were HA and are void. ADX<15 n=8 EV -0.481% (t about -1), the hours added on 07-28 (00-02, 04-11) n=29 EV -0.089% (t -0.34, restated from break-even but still indistinguishable from zero, and reverting them drops frequency to 0.39/day which fails the >=1-signal-per-2-days requirement S2 exists to meet), |stretch| and RSI depth show no gradient, both directions positive, and coin pruning on backtest output stays forbidden. Nothing clears the n>=5-with-signal bar. AVAILABILITY: watchdog never fired in anger, candle continuity unbroken every hour since 07-29 02:07 -- the 07-29 freeze fix holds. Live evidence is still n=1 closed trade.
